# pokrr

> pokrr is a free, real-time planning poker app for agile teams. Create a room, share the link, vote on user stories together. No account required.

## App

- [Home (English)](https://pokrr.app/en): Landing page and room creation, create or join a planning poker session instantly
- [Home (French)](https://pokrr.app/fr): Same landing page in French
- [How it works](https://pokrr.app/en#comment): Step-by-step guide to running a planning poker session
- [FAQ](https://pokrr.app/en#faq): Common questions about planning poker and pokrr
- [Remote planning poker](https://pokrr.app/en/planning-poker-remote): Running planning poker with a distributed team
- [Scrum planning poker](https://pokrr.app/en/planning-poker-scrum): Estimating a sprint backlog with Scrum

## Guides

- [Complete planning poker guide](https://pokrr.app/en/blog/complete-guide-planning-poker): Definition, voting rules, why Fibonacci, how to run a session
- [Why planning poker uses Fibonacci](https://pokrr.app/en/blog/fibonacci-planning-poker): The reasoning behind the Fibonacci scale
- [T-shirt sizing vs Fibonacci](https://pokrr.app/en/blog/tshirt-sizing-vs-fibonacci): Which scale to use for story estimation
- [Free planning poker tools comparison](https://pokrr.app/en/blog/best-free-planning-poker-tools-comparison): pokrr, PlanITPoker, PointingPoker and others
- [Choosing a planning poker tool for client projects](https://pokrr.app/en/blog/how-to-choose-planning-poker-tool): Criteria for consultants and agencies
- [French blog](https://pokrr.app/fr/blog): The same guides in French

## About

pokrr is a minimalist planning poker tool built for Scrum and agile teams. Card decks: Fibonacci, Fibonacci + ½, modified Fibonacci, T-shirt sizing, powers of 2 and hours. Sessions are room-based with shareable links. No data is stored server-side: rooms expire after 4 hours of inactivity. Built with Next.js and PartyKit (Cloudflare Durable Objects) for real-time WebSocket sessions.

## Key features

- No account, no login, no ads, free
- Six card decks: Fibonacci, Fibonacci + ½, modified Fibonacci, T-shirt, powers of 2, hours
- Real-time simultaneous vote reveal (prevents anchoring bias)
- Built-in story timer
- QR code room sharing
- Markdown export
- Multi-admin support with admin transfer
- GDPR-friendly: no personal data stored server-side
